cells.scene: Two handmade wooden chairs stand side by side; one has precise smooth joints and strong construction, the other is visibly wobbly and rough.
A rooster stands on a fence at dawn with beak open and small sound-wave marks, morning sky behind.
Two small songbirds sit on a branch with open beaks and tiny light sound marks, gentle chirping scene.
A small silver ring catches one sharp flash of sunlight on its edge, restrained bright sparkle.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — superior (a.优越的): Two handmade wooden chairs stand side by side; one has precise smooth joints and strong construction, the other is visibly wobbly and rough.
TOP RIGHT — cockcrow (n.鸡叫): A rooster stands on a fence at dawn with beak open and small sound-wave marks, morning sky behind.
BOTTOM LEFT — twitter (v.(鸟)吱吱叫，嘁嘁喳喳叫): Two small songbirds sit on a branch with open beaks and tiny light sound marks, gentle chirping scene.
BOTTOM RIGHT — glint (v.闪烁): A small silver ring catches one sharp flash of sunlight on its edge, restrained bright sparkle.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: All course meanings, anatomy and white margins passed visual review. Superior contrasts sound and flimsy chair quality; cockcrow has a crowing rooster at sunrise; twitter is birds chirping; glint is a small light flash; dubious is skeptical inspection and acquaintance is a casual greeting.
